annotations.title: Ask wooden house manufacturers for quotes

description: Sends a design to the Geoniks team, who forward it with the person's contact details to timber-house manufacturers that build in their country, so they receive real price offers by email. Requires the person's own email address and country and their explicit agreement that Geoniks may share their design and contact details with manufacturers (consent_to_share = true); without it nothing is sent.

area_m2.description: Floor area in m², if there is no design_id.

budget.description: Budget range, if the person said.

consent_to_share.description: true only if the person agreed that Geoniks shares their design and contact details with manufacturers.

country.description: Country where they want to build. When signed in, the account's country is used if this is left out.

design_id.description: Id of a Geoniks design to send with the request.

email.description: The person's email address, as they gave it. Not needed when signed in with Geoniks (taken from the account).

includes.description: What the price should cover, if the person said (kit only … turnkey).
enum: House kit only (walls, floors, roof structure)

notes.description: Wishes: budget, timing, plot, wood type, anything the manufacturer should know.

phone.description: Phone number with country code (optional; manufacturers often reply by phone).

start.description: When they want to build, if the person said.

user_request.description: What the person asked for, in one short sentence in their own words (no contact details).

name: request_manufacturer_quotes
title: Ask wooden house manufacturers for quotes
